_doc: tools/lidar_connector_profile.py (ledger 0079 rounds H-I): each street's road surface height at each of the source track's connector points, the median of the lidar ground (class 2) and bridge deck (class 17) returns within 1.0 m [invented radius] (min 3 returns), local frame (z - origin.elev_m); round I --surface: where a deck stands 2 m [invented] or more over the ground at a point, the road is the surface continuous with the street (a street under a bridge stays on its ground; round H's four streets read the same). Round I: every street with lidar, except those whose profile jumps more than 0.5 m [invented] between two neighbouring points (3 m apart; 3DEP's own largest is 0.56 m): grid_secondary_8, grid_primary_11, grid_secondary_39, grid_secondary_42, grid_primary_71, grid_unclassified_77 (held on 3DEP, ledger 0079 round I). NOT WIRED (ledger 0079 round I item 4): with these 100 streets the build (sclm_work i3, i5) is green but for one mouth: grid_tertiary_1#1 start on grid_tertiary_2#0, HOST LANE a road sheet 0.021 m over the host deck (LANE_TOL 0.02 m) and 2 grass samples 4 mm under it, 7 m along the host past the span. It fails the same with grid_tertiary_1 back on 3DEP (i5), so it is the host grid_tertiary_2 on the lidar. To wire: point lm_intake.connector_profiles here, and hold grid_tertiary_2 (or mend that weld) and rebuild.
